name: Performance
description: How fast the feature feels and how much it costs the device. Measured: its share of the shipped bundle, cold start, the p95 of its main interaction, p95 frame time while it animates or scrolls, and memory after its main flow. Every probe is a command the product's lens-scan overlay names, so a baseline and a fix run the same probe.

fields.label: Bundle share
fields.description: The feature's share of the shipped client bundle, read from the build's stats file. Omitted when the build names no stats file.

fields.label: Cold start
fields.description: Cold start to the first interactive frame of the feature's entry screen.

fields.label: Interaction p95
fields.description: p95 of the feature's main interaction, from input to the next paint, over 20 or more samples.

fields.label: Frame p95
fields.description: p95 frame time while the feature animates or scrolls. 16.7 ms is 60 frames a second.

fields.label: Memory
fields.description: Resident memory after the feature's main flow. No target: a budget is the app's own.

fields.label: Budget met
fields.description: Whether the feature meets the performance budget the product set for it.

fields.label: Probed on
fields.description: Where the probes ran (a local production build, a named device). Readings from different places do not compare.
